title: PTP Production Validation
description: Stress-test PTP correction under fixed, variable, burst, and asymmetric latency

hypothesis.statement: PTP maintains bounded drift (< δ) at all latencies including adversarial conditions

key_findings: Fixed Latency: bounded=NO, worst drift=1.1195 at L=0, best drift=0.0548 at L=100
Variable Latency [0, L]: bounded=NO, worst drift=1.1195 at L=0, best drift=0.0232 at L=200
Burst Latency (10× spikes): bounded=NO, worst drift=1.1195 at L=0, best drift=0.0886 at L=50
Asymmetric Latency (2:1 send/recv): bounded=NO, worst drift=0.8954 at L=0, best drift=0.0689 at L=100
High jitter (>0.001) at 1/32 conditions. Worst jitter: 0.001826 at L=200 mode=BURST
FIXED: drift scaling = 0.20× when latency goes from ≤20 to >20. Sublinear — PTP absorbs latency well.
VARIABLE: drift scaling = 0.11× when latency goes from ≤20 to >20. Sublinear — PTP absorbs latency well.
BURST: drift scaling = 0.38× when latency goes from ≤20 to >20. Sublinear — PTP absorbs latency well.
ASYMMETRIC: drift scaling = 0.25× when latency goes from ≤20 to >20. Sublinear — PTP absorbs latency well.
HYPOTHESIS REJECTED: PTP drift exceeds 10δ in some conditions. See per-condition details for breakdown.
